requestId.description: The ID of the request. This is generated from the [Estimate delivery](#tag/Delivery-as-a-Service/paths/~1delivery~1estimate/post) endpoint

collect.description: Collect point used to identify the pick-up address. Represents a restaurant, a grocery store, or any other collect point. The available collect points can be retrieved using the [Get Collect Points](#tag/Delivery-as-a-Service/paths/~1delivery~1collect-points/get) endpoint.

delivery.description: Delivery point used to identify the delivery address. Represents a customer, or any other delivery point.

deliveryDetails.description: Optional information about the items included in this delivery.  Note -- this will be required for the following markets [BE, BG, DK, IT, NL, PL, ES, CH].

deliveryOptions.description: Optional settings pertaining to the delivery preferences.

targetDeliverTime.description: Supply this parameter to set up an advance order. It is the time in UTC for which the order should be delivered to the customer. This value must be between 1 hour to 5 days in advance. You may only specify either the `targetCollectTime` or `targetDeliverTime` with an advance order request. **Note: Currently not supported for the following markets [BE, BG, DK, IT, NL, PL, ES, CH]**

targetCollectTime.description: Supply this parameter to set up an advance order. It is the time in UTC for which the courier should arrive to collect the order. This value must be between 1 hour to 5 days in advance. You may only specify either the `targetCollectTime` or `targetDeliverTime` with an advance order request. **Note: Currently not supported for the following markets [BE, BG, DK, IT, NL, PL, ES, CH]**

hasAlcohol.description: This previous `hasAlcohol` flag can no longer be used.  If `true`, an error will be returned and the estimate will be discarded.  Use the `deliveryDetails.hasAlcohol` flag instead for orders with alcohol.

itemList.description: List of item to be included in the delivery.  This is required if the `proofOfPickup` flag is present as a part of `deliveryOptions`.

phoneNumber.description:
Phone number of the recipient.

A phone number can be represented in:
  - E.164 format e.g. +447777111111 or;
  - Local format of submitted tenant e.g. 07777111111.

E.164 formatted phone numbers are preferred.

postalCode.description: Postal code of the recipient’s address.

geolocation.description: Coordinates of the recipient’s address to be used for the delivery. **(Note: This is mandatory for the following markets [BE, BG, DK, IT, NL, PL, ES, CH])**

SharedGeoJsonPoint.description: The coordinates of a geographical location.

coordinates.description: The only two elements are latitude and longitude precisely in that order and using decimal numbers.

type.description: The type of geospatial data this represents. The only supported value is 'Point' in GeoJSON format as defined in [RFC 7946](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7946).

DaasDaaSDeliveryDetails.description: Details about the items being delivered.

weightGrams.description: Total weight of the items being delivered, in grams.

preparationDuration.description: Number of minutes required to prepare the delivery. Must be between 5 and 60 minutes. Required for ASAP orders (when neither `targetCollectTime` nor `targetDeliverTime` is specified). Optional for scheduled orders (when either `targetCollectTime` or `targetDeliverTime` is provided).

hasAlcohol.description: Whether the order contains alcohol or not. If not specified, the default is `false`.  If this is `true`, `ageRestriction` is required for the following markets [BE, BG, DK, IT, NL, PL, ES, CH].

ageRestriction.description: Customer age required in order to hand over delivery.  Note -- this is required if `hasAlcohol` is `true`.

ageVerificationWithId.description: Whether alcohol deliveries should use ID-scanning proof of delivery. If not specified, the default behaviour is `true`. This field is only supported when `hasAlcohol` is `true`.

proofOfDelivery.description: Proof of delivery protection to be used for the request, such as PIN codes.

unreachablePreference.description: The courier's action when a customer cannot be reached. If not specified, the default is `DROP_OFF`. Note -- this is currently not supported in the following markets [BE, BG, DK, IT, NL, PL, ES, CH].

proofOfPickup.description: Proof of pickup protection to be used for the request, such as barcodes. Note -- this is currently not supported in the following markets [BE, BG, DK, IT, NL, PL, ES, CH].

vehiclePreference.description: Optional settings to enforce specific vehicle types for the delivery, such as car-only deliveries. If not provided, the next available courier will be assigned regardless of vehicle type. **Note: Currently not supported in the following markets [BE, BG, DE, IT, NL, PL, ES, CH].**

dropoffAction.description: Specify the preferred delivery drop-off method. `CONTACTLESS` instructs the courier to leave the order at the customer's door without direct contact. `MEET_AT_DOOR` instructs the courier to hand the order directly to the customer. If not specified, the system defaults to `MEET_AT_DOOR`.

pinCode.description: Protect this delivery with a PIN code, which the customer must provide to the courier upon delivery.

DaasDaaSPinCode.description: Details about the type of PIN code.

type.description: Type of PIN code provider. Currently, only delivery service provider generated PIN code is supported.

barcode.description: Use barcode scanning as a proof of pickup for this delivery.  If this option is selected, barcode values must be provided in the `itemList`.  Note -- this is feature currently not supported in the following markets [BE, BG, DK, IT, NL, PL, ES, CH].

DaasDaaSBarcode.description: Details about the type of Barcode provider.

type.description: Type of barcode provider. Currently, only partner provided barcode is supported. Note -- this is currently not supported for the following markets [BE, BG, DK, IT, NL, PL, ES, CH].

carOnly.description: If `true`, the delivery will be assigned only to couriers using cars. If `false`, the next available courier will be assigned regardless of vehicle type, based on the partner's preferences.

DaasDaaSItem.description: Details about an item being delivered.

itemId.description: Identification code of the item.  This must be unique within a delivery.

quantity.description: Number of this item to be included in the delivery.

weight.description: Weight of a single item in grams.

barcode.description: Barcode of the item.  If the `deliveryOptions.proofOfPickup` type for this delivery is `barcode`, this field is required.

price.description: Price of the item in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

category.description: Category of the item. Defaults to FOOD if not provided.

type.description: Type of barcode for the item.

email.description: Email of the partner to contact in case there are any issues with the notifications.

endpoint.description: Partner's HTTPS endpoint to receive events and notifications. Make sure the endpoint is properly prefixed as we only support HTTPS (secure) URLs.

username.description: The username of the partner's credentials to store. Only required for type BASIC.

subscriptions.description: List of notification events to subscribe to.

email.description: Email of the partner to contact in case there are any issues with the notifications.

endpoint.description: Partner's HTTPS endpoint to receive events and notifications. Make sure the endpoint is properly prefixed as we only support HTTPS (secure) URLs.

username.description: The username of the partner's credentials to store. Only required for type BASIC.

subscriptions.description: List of notification events to subscribe to. The partner will be subscribed to all events if this parameter is not supplied. On the other hand, if an empty list is supplied, you will be unsubscribed from all events.

requestId.description: The ID of the request. This is generated from the [Estimate delivery](#tag/Delivery-as-a-Service/paths/~1delivery~1estimate/post) endpoint. The ID that was generated must be used within five minutes of a successful estimate, otherwise the ID will be considered expired. Once an ID has been used for a successful delivery creation, it cannot be reused thereafter.

specialInstructions.description: Instructions about the delivery that the customer wants to submit.

targetCollectTime.description: Time in UTC when the partners wish to have the order collected from the restaurant. Required if target deliver time was not specified in the Estimate delivery request.

tip.description: Tip paid to the courier for a delivery in cents

orderValue.description: Total value of an order in cents.

vendorOrderId.description: Order ID supplied by the partner referencing the order within their systems. This will be mandatory in the following markets [BE, BG, DK, IT, NL, PL, ES, CH]. This should be a human-readable value as it will be displayed for the courier during the pickup process, and is strongly recommended not to be a UUID. Note, if the partner does not supply this value, JET will auto-generate a number instead.

paymentType.description: Specify the preferred payment type for the delivery. Deliveries will either be PREPAID or COD (Cash on Delivery). If COD is chosen, please ensure that the price in the order value field includes all potential surcharges such as tax. **Note:** Cash on Delivery (COD) is currently supported only in the BG (Bulgaria) market.

metadata.description: Key-value map of partner custom identifiers. These identifiers will be included in webhook notifications. Values cannot exceed 255 characters.

requestId.description: The ID of the request. This is generated from the [Estimate delivery](#tag/Delivery-as-a-Service/paths/~1delivery~1estimate/post) endpoint

collect.description: Collect point used to identify the pick-up address. Represents a restaurant, a grocery store, or any other collect point. The available collect points can be retrieved using the [Get Collect Points](#tag/Delivery-as-a-Service/paths/~1delivery~1collect-points/get) endpoint.

reason.description: Reason used to identify the reason for which a partner needs help.

requestId.description: The ID of the request. This is generated from the [Estimate delivery](#tag/Delivery-as-a-Service/paths/~1delivery~1estimate/post) endpoint.

deliveryStep.description: The step until which the delivery should be simulated. This is an optional field. If not provided, the delivery will be simulated until the DELIVERED step. If a delivery is simulated for any step before DELIVERED, it can be simulated again for any subsequent step; the simulation will then resume from the point where the previous simulation for that request ended.

stepWaitDuration.description: The delay between each delivery step in milliseconds.
